compute_summary: MDLM-OWT 130M, batch 1, lr 1e-4, 200 steps, institutional HPC 2x H100 NVL, 12 lanes total, wall time ~1.5 min for 27 cells.
mechanism_implication: Pre-equilibrium saturation is direction-driven, with init-direction alignment delaying but not preventing the rapid-post-update concentration. Spectral-aligned init perturbs initial-state but masked-CE gradient still drives toward argmax concentration. PiSSA without lr rescaling is gradient-unstable on DLM PEFT.
preregistered_threshold: WORKS: step-0 top-1 freq <= 0.58 at r=64 rho in {0.40,0.90} AND fire-rate <27/27. PARTIAL: fire-step median delays beyond 11. DOESN'T: fire 27/27 + fire-step 11.
prior_art_note: PiSSA (Meng et al. 2024, NeurIPS 2024 spotlight) proposed for AR LoRA convergence; we test orthogonal hypothesis on DLM PEFT top-1 saturation. PiSSA's reported faster-convergence benefit is for AR fine-tuning; on DLM PEFT, the spectral-aligned init delays saturation but does not prevent it and breaks gradient stability under standard lr.
schema: K15o PiSSA-style spectral init intervention: A=sqrt(S)*V^T, B=U*sqrt(S) (truncated to rank r) of base weight SVD. Tests INIT-DIRECTION axis. MDLM-OWT 130M, r in {4,16,64} x rho in {0.05,0.40,0.90} x n=3 seeds = 27 cells.
verdict_explanation: PARTIAL: fire-step median delayed 11 -> 33 (3x) showing direction-init alignment with pretrained spectral structure modulates saturation TIMING. But fire-rate stays 27/27 (saturation still fires, just later) AND max-grad explodes ~203586x vs baseline (PiSSA init norm = sqrt(S) of base weight, large; first gradient step overshoots wildly without lr rescaling). Final-loss also worse (+3.16 paired). NOT a working fix. Adds mechanism nuance: direction-init affects WHEN, not WHETHER.
